related.title: 矽自旋 Ramsey：準靜態雜訊與相干包絡
related.titleEn: Silicon-spin Ramsey: quasistatic noise and coherence envelopes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若分布無法由共同有效溫度描述，退回多能階動力模型，不宣稱降溫必能修復所有錯誤。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: If one effective temperature cannot describe populations, use a multilevel kinetic model rather than assuming cooling cures every error. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 比較高斯相干衰減與單一指數衰減，避免只報一個T₂數字。
related.differenceEn: Compare Gaussian and exponential coherence decay instead of reporting an unexplainedT2.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。教學能隙Δ=100μeV、k=86.17μeV/K、電子溫度0.1K。 P激發=1/[1+exp(100/(86.17×0.1))]。 代入 1/(1+exp(100/(86.17*0.1)))，得到 9.12059e-06 dimensionless。兩個非簡併能階在熱平衡下P激發=1/[1+exp(Δ/kT)]；多谷、多自旋與非平衡需擴充配分函數。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。延遲t=10μs，T₂*=20μs，起始對比已正規化為1。 C=exp[−(10/20)²]。 代入 exp(-(10/20)**2)，得到 0.778801 normalized contrast。準靜態高斯失諧下取C(t)=exp[−(t/T₂*)²]；這是歸一化包絡，非完整振盪訊號。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Teaching gapΔ=100μeV, k=86.17μeV/K and electron temperature0.1K. Pexc=1/[1+exp(100/(86.17×0.1))]. Substituting 1/(1+exp(100/(86.17*0.1))) gives 9.12059e-06 dimensionless. For two nondegenerate levels at equilibrium Pexc=1/[1+exp(Δ/kT)]; extra valleys, spins and nonequilibrium require a larger partition function. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Delayt=10μs, T2*=20μs and normalized initial contrast1. C=exp[−(10/20)²]. Substituting exp(-(10/20)**2) gives 0.778801 normalized contrast. For quasistatic Gaussian detuning use C(t)=exp[−(t/T2*)²], a normalized envelope rather than the full oscillation. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 建立能辨別操作次序的量測，避免測到相同Z人口就宣稱兩操作可交換。
related.differenceEn: Construct an order-sensitive measurement instead of inferring commutation from equalZ populations.

P(+X)=(1+sin(π/2)cos(π/2))/2. Substituting (1+sin(pi/2)*cos(pi/2))/2 gives 0.5 probability. Starting+Z, applyRx(α) thenRy(β): finalX=sinβcosα, soP(+X)=(1+sinβcosα)/2; abstract rotations do not prove physical braiding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
